# VOwn (vown.site)

> VOwn is a modern technology studio specializing in AI automation for businesses, software tool integrations, and custom website development.

## Overview
VOwn helps businesses eliminate repetitive manual busywork by connecting software tools, building intelligent automated workflows, and engineering fast, responsive modern websites.

- **Website**: https://vown.site
- **Contact Email**: admin@vown.site
- **Primary Domain**: vown.site

## Core Services

### 1. AI Automation
Automating repetitive administrative and operational workflows to save time and reduce manual errors.
- **URL**: https://vown.site/services#ai-automation
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Automated document processing (invoice parsing, receipts, text extraction)
  - Smart inquiry routing and customer message classification
  - Internal knowledge assistants grounded in company documents
  - Automated daily business summaries and milestone alerts

### 2. Business Software Integrations
Connecting disconnected software stacks so data synchronizes seamlessly across tools.
- **URL**: https://vown.site/services#business-integrations
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - CRM and customer database synchronization (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive)
  - Payment and automated invoicing workflows (Stripe, QuickBooks)
  - Real-time team notifications (Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp)
  - Spreadsheet, database, and cloud API connectors (PostgreSQL, Supabase, Notion, Airtable)

### 3. Website Development
Building fast, clean, high-performance websites engineered for modern businesses.
- **URL**: https://vown.site/services#website-development
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Sub-second loading speeds optimized for Core Web Vitals
  - Responsive mobile-first design
  - Clear, human-centered messaging that turns visitors into clients
  - Frictionless inquiry forms and booking links

## Working Approach
VOwn follows a transparent 4-phase methodology:
1. **Discover**: Identify repetitive bottlenecks and map the client's current software stack.
2. **Design**: Plan visual layouts and data flow maps in plain English before writing code.
3. **Build**: Engineer reliable solutions with modern, tested tools and rigorous testing.
4. **Improve**: Launch smoothly, walk the client through the system, and provide ongoing iteration.
- **URL**: https://vown.site/approach

## Company Philosophy & Values
- **Utility Over Hype**: Focusing on real time savings and business utility rather than buzzwords.
- **Client Ownership**: Clients own 100% of their code, credentials, and digital assets.
- **Direct Collaboration**: Clients communicate directly with designers and builders.
- **URL**: https://vown.site/about

- **Inquiry Page**: https://vown.site/contact
